title: TechVault baseline benchmark
description: Benchmark collection for TechVault red-team runs.
purpose: Compare participant policies across repeated executions of the same task.
research_questions: How often does each participant policy achieve initial foothold under the fixed task protocol?
inclusion_criteria: Runs must use the declared task version and reference apparatus context.
Runs with unresolved setup deviations are excluded from benchmark estimates.
run_allocation: Allocate equal repeated runs per participant policy.

analysis_plan.description: Estimate success proportion with uncertainty per participant policy.

validity_notes.note: Repeated runs are required before drawing comparison claims.
